inputs.prompt: An exact 4 columns by 4 rows grid sprite atlas of sixteen minimalist mobile game toolbar icons. Pure solid black background in every cell, no frames, no text, no letters, no shadows. Each icon is a simple elegant pale gold and jade line silhouette with thick readable strokes and very few details, centered in its own equal square cell with generous 25 percent margins. Chinese fantasy UI. Read left to right top to bottom: row one sorting three horizontal lines with downward arrow; small pagoda shop; blacksmith hammer; closed envelope. Row two selling coin; dismantle crossed tools; organize grid of four squares; scroll manuscript. Row three diamond gemstone; three merging pearls; ascending star with up arrow; two curved transfer arrows. Row four save disk; back arrow; left chevron; right chevron. Uniform size and stroke width, flat clean pictograms, restrained gold jade two color palette, crisp clear readable silhouette.
inputs.negative_prompt: blurry, low quality, watermark, text, deformed, extra limbs
